newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Malaysian palm oil refiners to visit Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian palm oil refiners to visit Pakistan.

text.p: A 14-member team of the Palm Oil Refiners Association of Malaysia (PORAM) will arrive in Karachi on Sunday for a five-day visit to Pakistan, dealers said on Saturday.
The team would meet government officials, cooking oil processors, soap manufacturers and importers of palm oil in Karachi and Lahore, one dealer said.

Pakistan palm oil imports fell to 497,269 tonnes worth $271 million in the first eight months of 1996/97 (July-June) compared to 626,536 tonnes worth $506 million in the year-ago period. -- Karachi newsroom 9221-5685192
